entries.en: Makeshift defenses. Untrained civilians. It's a miracle anyone's still standing.
These people came here looking for a better life. And look what happened.
Nice place to visit, but I wouldn't want to live here. Scratch that; it's not a nice place to visit.
Gotta give these colonists credit; they don't give up easy.
So much suffering. So much death. Yet still they stay and fight.
They tried to build a life here, but now all they have are ruins.
I can't believe the colony held out as long as it did.
This place has seen better days.
These people are brave, but the geth are relentless. My people know this better than anyone.
These colonists may not have much, but this is their home. They will fight to the death to defend it.
